crushes in a controlled manner, converting some of the kinetic energy into deformation,

sometimes the sides of the cabin. It inflates during the impact and increases impact time to
reduce force of impact when passenger’s head is press against the interior of the car.

Describe the observations made by Hubble that led him to the conclusion that our Universe is 3
© Expansion of universe conclusion linked to observations 3
© Response is in a clear and logical manner
¢ of universe conclusion linked to observations
Hubble observed the spectra of a number of galaxies. He found that the spectral lines were
shifted to the red end of the spectrum — i.e. red shift. There was a greater degree of red shift
with the more distant galaxies. This relationship gave rise to the Hubble constant and led
Hubble to conclude that the universe must be expanding, as there could be no other explanation
The link between greater distance of galaxies and their increased red shift was not well
established. Some weaker responses suggested that red tinging of light was the same as the shift
of spectral lines towards the red end of the spectrum — note that an emission line can be of any
colour other than red (even violet) and still display red shift due to the Doppler effect.
